owner_reply: Duyệt VM riêng và bounded fixtures
growth_definition: Allocated bytes in new Lima VM directory, downloaded tooling/images and private20K experiment output. A sparse48GiB VM disk is measured by allocated blocks, not logical length. Guest disk usage is monitored independently; do not double-count guest blocks inside the host VM disk.
wall_definition: First software-install/VM mutation through installation, image build and bounded fixture acceptance; start stored in exclusive private execution receipt. Quota wait occurred before start.
source_scope: Project-owned fixtures only; no private source replay/download
profiles: Core first; Elasticsearch/API only after measured request/usage budget passes. Dashboard excluded, optional multi-node documentation only.
protected: Original Lima k VM, all accepted Kafka/MinIO volumes/topics/prefixes/checkpoints, private source archives/ledgers and Phase13-20 evidence
stop: Resource/time/correctness failure cancels only current owned job; retain new failure evidence, no automatic timeout increase, VM resize or source replay
quota: Check actual current session rate limits at safe stages; stop with10percent or less remaining and resume after confirmed refill. Do not start a bounded long service stage if quota interruption would consume its wall cap.
kubernetes_claim: Single-node LinuxARM64 local demonstration; no HA, node-loss durability, broker failover or horizontal scaling
